page: p. 41 (leaf n60), inline in the commentary
object: label to figure D of procession I
site: Philae, Temple of Isis, the 'Meroitic Chamber'
notes: Published L., D., VI, Bl. 4, no. 10. The type runs over two lines of print; Griffith's print breaks after ponni; ponni + lito are joined here as one word, so the two printed lines are one entry (Griffith's 'Penani'; cf. adlito in 104; FHN III no. 267 also has ponnilito). Griffith: 'Mashtaraq, qeren of Penani. The omission of the initial qo is curious.'
